invariants.rationale: The method always returns a new AvroReaderContextFactory, which is never null.
metaClient is provided as a parameter and passed to the constructor, and the method would throw an error if null.
The method body always instantiates and returns an AvroReaderContextFactory.
The returned object is always created via 'new AvroReaderContextFactory', so its class is AvroReaderContextFactory, not a subclass.
metaClient is declared as HoodieTableMetaClient, so it must be an instance, barring null.
